scope: Art-only redraw of the source field-gun model shared by partisan and Italian crews. No new historical model or runtime replacement.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game asset redraw. Production pixel-art replacement for this EXACT existing side-view field gun, matching the chunky dark-outlined flat-shaded game sprite style of the provided gun crew. Source gun references define mechanical silhouette and construction; crew reference defines palette, pixel density and outline treatment only. Keep the source's single visible spoked wheel, long slender horizontal barrel, rear breech, simple lever, and leftward trail; no modern shield, extra barrel, extra wheels, insignia, people or different artillery model. Neutral desaturated olive painted metal, dark charcoal outline, restrained warm gray highlights and dark olive shadows, small readable bolts and worn edges. This must look hand-pixelled for an actual game, not photo-realistic, smooth-vector, 3D-rendered, weathered with tiny noise, or cute. True alpha-zero TRANSPARENT background, solid sprite pixels, no ground/grass/shadow, glow, labels, borders, muzzle flash, smoke or scenery. Exact SIDE-ON view facing RIGHT with no perspective.
DRAW ONLY THE DETACHABLE UPPER BARREL/BREECH/CRADLE ASSEMBLY from reference image1. Image2 shows where this upper assembly sits on the complete source gun; do not include any lower carriage, wheel, trail or ground. Image3 crew is style-only. Preserve the original component's long slim silhouette at aspect 274:52, its barrel pointing exactly horizontally RIGHT, square rear breech around x47..130, thin underside recoil/cradle rail, small sight, and upward-slanting thin operating lever around source x83..100. Keep original barrel proportions: bore tip at source (273,36), trunnion/rotation centre at source (137,26), and the original lower rail to the left. Add readable material shading and small construction detail within this silhouette; do not turn this into a thick modern howitzer or disconnected tube.
Canvas 1536x1024, one isolated component centered. Requested placement: the original 274x52 design enlarged 5x occupies rectangle (83,382)..(1453,642), giving 1370x260 pixels; no object parts outside that rectangle. Thus the rotation point is near canvas (768,512), and muzzle near (1448,562). Keep the long component fully visible with generous transparent margins. Draw the complete component, not a close-up crop. Dark contours should read 1–2 pixels at final 274x52 game-asset size, not thick cartoon blobs. No stand, mount legs or wheel in this upper-part image.

prompts.prompt: Edit this lower field-gun carriage image, keeping exactly its current olive/gray chunky outlined pixel-art style and transparent canvas. Two precise geometry corrections to match the source gun: (1) reduce the WHOLE circular wheel including tyre/rim/spokes/hub to 84% of its current diameter, uniformly about its current centre. Keep that wheel CENTRE in exactly the same place. Do not move or scale the long leftward trail and rear spade; connect the trail/axle naturally into the now smaller wheel. This makes the trail longer relative to wheel diameter, as in the original source. (2) Move the round UPPER trunnion/hinge joint about 40 pixels to the RIGHT while keeping its height unchanged; adapt its short supporting cheeks naturally down to the axle. Keep all other parts and their source positions. No upper gun barrel, people, grass, base slab or ground. Circle must remain side-on and perfectly round, spokes clear. Remove the soft luminous halo: background is fully transparent, sprite pixels hard and opaque. Keep the complete entire carriage visible without clipping. Canvas remains 1536x1024.
prompts.selection: Selected carriage with revised wheel/trunnion proportions and no painted ground.
